module.purpose: Provides reusable value predicates and environment-compatible deep-cloning utilities for the package.
module.summary: This module exports generic type-narrowing predicates for undefined, null, and nullish values. It selects a deep-cloning implementation during module initialization by checking available global environments in order, preferring native structured cloning and falling back to JSON serialization. It also exposes whether native cloning was selected and the cloned-object prototype used for compatibility workarounds.
module.businessContext: Shared utilities support safe data validation and copying across browser, Node, and test environments. Failure can cause incorrect type narrowing, lost object data, or environment-specific cloning errors.
functions: isDefined (~L20-22): Narrows values by confirming they are not undefined.
isNonNull (~L43-45): Narrows values by confirming they are not null.
isNonNullish (~L66-70): Narrows values by excluding both null and undefined.
getStructuredClone (~L72-86): Selects native or JSON-based deep-cloning behavior.
structuredClone (~L109): Exposes the selected deep-cloning implementation for callers.

sectionMap.name: value predicates
sectionMap.intent: Evaluate nullability predicates and provide compile-time type narrowing.

sectionMap.name: globalThis feature detection
sectionMap.intent: Prefer the globally available native structured-cloning implementation.

sectionMap.name: Node global feature detection
sectionMap.intent: Use the Node global clone implementation when globalThis did not provide one.

sectionMap.name: window feature detection
sectionMap.intent: Use the browser window clone implementation when earlier environments lack one.

sectionMap.name: JSON clone fallback
sectionMap.intent: Clone truthy values through JSON serialization when native support is unavailable.

sectionMap.name: clone implementation initialization
sectionMap.intent: Select and cache the cloning function and native-support flag.

sectionMap.name: prototype compatibility initialization
sectionMap.intent: Capture the prototype used by cloned objects for test-environment compatibility.

invariants.description: The defined-value predicate returns true exactly when the input is not undefined.
The non-null predicate returns true exactly when the input is not null.
The non-nullish predicate returns true only when neither null nor undefined is present.

units.name: isDefined

detail.name: isDefined
detail.signature: export function isDefined<T>(value: T): value is typeof value extends undefined ? never : T
detail.returnType: value is typeof value extends undefined ? never : T
postconditions: Returns false exactly when value is undefined.
Returns true for every value that is not undefined, including null.
invariants: The input value is not mutated.
edgeCases: When value is undefined, returns false.
When value is null, returns true.
When value is any other value, including falsy primitives such as false, 0, and an empty string, returns true.
detail.summary: Determines whether a value is not undefined and narrows the value's type accordingly.

units.name: isNonNull

detail.name: isNonNull
detail.signature: export function isNonNull<T>(value: T): value is typeof value extends null ? never : T
detail.returnType: value is typeof value extends null ? never : T
preconditions: A value of any type assignable to the generic parameter T may be supplied.
postconditions: Returns true only when the supplied value is not null.
When true, the value is narrowed according to the declared type predicate.
invariants: The input value is not mutated.
The function has no external side effects.
edgeCases: undefined is not null and returns true.
Falsy non-null values such as false, 0, and an empty string return true.
Objects, arrays, functions, and symbols return true.
detail.summary: Determines whether a value is not null and narrows the value's type accordingly. The predicate excludes null while preserving other possible values, including undefined.

specTests.when: isNonNull is called for each value.
specTests.then: The result is true for both values.

detail.name: isNonNullish
detail.signature: export function isNonNullish<T>(value: T): value is NonNullable<T>
postconditions: Returns true exactly when the input is not null and not undefined.
When true, the input is type-narrowed to NonNullable<T>.
invariants: The input value is not mutated.
The result depends only on whether the input is nullish.
edgeCases: For all other values, including false, 0, empty strings, NaN, objects, and arrays, returns true.
detail.summary: Determines whether a value is neither null nor undefined, while narrowing its type to NonNullable<T>.

units.name: getStructuredClone

detail.name: getStructuredClone
postconditions: Returns a two-element tuple whose first element has the generic clone-function shape and whose second element indicates structured-clone availability.
invariants: Runtime capability checks do not mutate application state.
edgeCases: When globalThis.structuredClone is available, it is selected and the availability flag is true.
When globalThis.structuredClone is unavailable but global.structuredClone is available, the global implementation is selected and the availability flag is true.
When neither globalThis nor global provides structuredClone but window.structuredClone is available, the window implementation is selected and the availability flag is true.
When the checked runtime environments do not provide structuredClone, the function returns its fallback tuple as defined by the implementation.
detail.summary: Resolves an available structured-cloning function from the runtime environment and reports whether one was found.
